goal.en: Get a local prepaid SIM card with the right amount of data.
goal.zh: 辦一張流量剛好的當地預付卡。

background: bright small phone shop interior, white counter with demo phones showing blank screens, wall shelves of colorful phone cases, two tall stools, a potted plant, clean modern lighting, afternoon

intro.en: Day three in Maple Bay. Your Taiwan phone number doesn't work here, so you need a local SIM card.
intro.zh: 來楓灣的第三天。台灣的手機門號在這裡不能用，你需要一張當地的 SIM 卡。

intro.en: The phone shop is bright, cool and very quiet.
intro.zh: 電信行裡明亮、涼爽，而且很安靜。

lines.en: Hi, welcome in! What can I do for you today?
lines.zh: 嗨，歡迎光臨！今天需要什麼服務？

choices.en: Hi. I'd like a SIM card, please.
choices.zh: 嗨，我想辦一張 SIM 卡。
choices.tip: I'd like... 比 I want... 客氣，是在店裡提出需求的好用句型。

choices.en: Hi. I want to do a phone number.

lines.en: Do a phone number? You mean... call someone?
lines.zh: 做一個電話號碼？你是說……打電話給誰嗎？

story.en: Lily kindly hands you the shop phone so you can make a call. You don't know anyone's number, so you just stand there holding it.
story.zh: 莉莉好心地把店裡的電話遞給你，讓你打電話。可是你誰的號碼都不知道，只能拿著話筒呆站著。

fail.why: 「辦門號」的「辦」不能直譯成 do。要說 I'd like a SIM card. 或 I'd like to get a phone number.

choices.en: Hi. SIM card. The cheapest one.
choices.zh: 嗨。SIM 卡。最便宜的那種。

lines.en: Okay... the cheapest one has no data at all.
lines.zh: 好喔……最便宜的那張完全沒有上網流量喔。

title.en: You Get What You Ask For

story.en: Lily sells you exactly what you asked for. Your phone can make calls, but there are no maps, no messages and no internet.
story.zh: 莉莉賣給你的正是你要的。你的手機可以打電話，但沒有地圖、沒有訊息，也不能上網。

fail.why: 只丟關鍵字聽起來很不耐煩，店員也懶得幫你找適合的方案。先說 I'd like a SIM card, please.，再一起討論需要什麼。

lines.en: Sure! Do you want prepaid, or a monthly contract?
lines.zh: 沒問題！你要預付卡，還是月租綁約？

choices.tip: prepaid 是先付費再使用，不用綁約，適合短期居留。

choices.en: Contract. Is the phone free, then?
choices.zh: 綁約。那手機是免費的嗎？

lines.en: A free phone? Only with a two-year contract.
lines.zh: 免費手機？要綁兩年約才有喔。

story.en: You almost sign up for two years. Then you remember your visa is for one year, and Lily has to shred all the paperwork.
story.zh: 你差點就簽了兩年約。這時你才想起簽證只有一年，莉莉只好把整疊文件送進碎紙機。

fail.why: 台灣辦門號常有「0 元手機」，但通常要綁兩年約，比你待的時間還長。短期居留選預付卡最方便：Prepaid, please.

story.en: Lily picks for you: a monthly contract with a very long agreement in very small print. You sign it without reading a single line.
story.zh: 莉莉幫你選了：一份月租合約，條款又長、字又小。你一行都沒讀就簽了。

fail.why: A or B? 這種選擇問句不能用 Yes 回答，要從選項中挑一個：Prepaid, please.

lines.en: Prepaid it is. And how much data do you need?
lines.zh: 那就預付卡。你需要多少上網流量？

choices.tip: 回答流量用 About + 數量 + a month。

lines.en: Very many...? Okay, how about our biggest plan?
lines.zh: 非常多……？好吧，那我們最大的方案如何？

story.en: Lily sells you the 100 GB plan. You'll never use even half of it, but you'll pay for all of it every month.
story.zh: 莉莉賣給你 100 GB 的方案。你連一半都用不完，卻每個月都要付全額。

fail.why: data 是不可數名詞，不能用 many，要說 a lot of data。更好的做法是直接說數量：About 10 GB a month.

choices.en: My birth date? It's December twelfth.
choices.zh: 我的出生日期？十二月十二號。

lines.en: Happy early birthday? But I said data. Internet!
lines.zh: 提早祝你生日快樂？不過我說的是流量，上網用的！

story.en: Lily types your birthday into the system by mistake. Now the shop will send you a "Happy Birthday!" text every December.
story.zh: 莉莉不小心把你的生日輸入系統。從此每年十二月，電信行都會傳一封「生日快樂！」的簡訊給你。

fail.why: data（流量）和 date（日期）發音很像，要聽清楚。How much data? 是問每月需要多少上網流量，回答 About 10 GB a month. 就好。

lines.en: Perfect. That's thirty dollars a month, no contract. You're all set!
lines.zh: 太好了。每月三十塊，不用綁約。都辦好囉！

lines.en: Your phone buzzes. Four bars of signal!
lines.zh: 你的手機震了一下。訊號滿格！

story.en: You have a brand-new local number. The first thing you send is a photo of your latte to your family in Taiwan.
story.zh: 你有了全新的當地門號。你傳的第一則訊息，是一張拿鐵的照片，給在台灣的家人。

notes.zh: 我想辦一張 SIM 卡。
notes.explain: I'd like 是 I would like 的縮寫，比 I want 客氣。辦門號不能說 do a phone number。

example.en: I'd like a phone case, please.

notes.explain: prepaid 是先付費再使用，不用綁約；monthly contract 是月租綁約，通常要綁一到兩年。

notes.en: How much data do you need?
notes.explain: data 指手機上網流量。回答用 About + 數量 + a month，例如 About 10 GB a month.

example.en: I use about 5 GB a month.

notes.explain: data 和 date 發音很像，要靠上下文分辨。data 是不可數名詞，不能說 many data，要說 a lot of data。

example.en: I need a lot of data for videos.
example.zh: 我看影片需要很多流量。

notes.explain: 「0 元手機」在英語國家也有，但幾乎都要綁一到兩年約。只待一年的人，選預付卡最有彈性。

example.en: I'm only here for a year, so prepaid is better.
example.zh: 我只待一年，所以預付卡比較好。
